tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Identity navy, the same in every theme. The ground of every post image (episode cover, payoff, screenshot frame, code card) and the ink of the logo on paper.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Identity safety orange, the same in every theme. On posts: the episode tag, the logo dot, the hazard band, the hard shadow, and code keywords on navy (5.6:1). Never text on paper or white (2.6:1), never an icon color.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Identity paper, the same in every theme. Text and marks on navy in post images (14.5:1); the logo's ground.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange fill (5.6:1). Never white on orange (2.9:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on the blog and in UI.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks and panels on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and frames that must be seen (3.3:1 light, 3.5:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, navy-soft and orange-soft (13:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, captions and metadata on surface, surface-raised, navy-soft and orange-soft (5.3:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text: links and the episode number in running text, on surface, surface-raised, navy-soft and orange-soft (4.7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: navy-fill
tokens.usage: Navy blocks inside the UI (diagrams, the cover, header bars). Lifts in dark so it never sinks into the surface. Text on it is on-navy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy and navy-fill (9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: navy-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted panels: callouts, quoted replies on the blog. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a highlighted line or the current episode in a list. Text on it is ink or accent-text.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments and line numbers in the code card, and the source line under a screenshot caption, on navy only (7.3:1).

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings and numbers in the code card, on navy only (10:1).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Post (1080 px canvas)
groups.note: Sizes for a 1080 × 1350 Threads image. One family, heavy titles, nothing below 26px so text survives a phone feed.

styles.name: post-title
styles.usage: The 3 to 5 word episode title. Paper on navy.

styles.name: post-tag
styles.usage: The episode tag, uppercase, on-orange on orange.

styles.name: post-lead
styles.usage: The first line of a payoff post or a screenshot caption.

styles.name: post-body
styles.usage: Reply summaries and short explanations. Three lines per point at most.

styles.name: post-meta
styles.usage: Handle and call to reply in the footer of every post.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: In my case, the export step took longer than the modeling.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tags and labels on screen.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: counts = Counter(e.Category.Name for e in elements)
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code on the blog.

styles.name: post-code
styles.usage: Code card images. 10 lines and 40 characters a line at most.

spacing.note: 4px base on screen; posts use the same steps scaled, plus one post margin.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks; the hazard band height on posts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between points on a post.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on the blog; the logo's minimum clear space on posts.

tokens.name: post-margin
tokens.usage: Inset from every edge of a 1080 × 1350 post. Nothing but the hazard band and full-bleed screenshots crosses it.

radius.note: Square, like site hoarding. Corners stay sharp; only the profile picture is round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: tags, cards, frames, buttons, post images.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form inputs on the blog, so they read as fields.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The circular profile picture only.

shadow.note: No soft shadows. One hard offset, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: The screenshot on a post and a featured card on the blog. One per image.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on links and buttons: a 2px surface gap, then 2px solid navy (light) or orange (dark), 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Dividers in line.

tokens.name: border-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke at 24px. Scale it with the icon (6px at 72px).
